prompt: Edit the owner-selected transparent Leo+Milo paired pose in reference 1. Keep the FRONT paw planted beside Milo as in reference 1, before the release. Leo looks down gently and considerately, soft attentive eyelids and relaxed brows, a calm closed neutral mouth; no wide-eyed surprise, raised startled brows, anger or threatening face. He is choosing restraint. Milo remains nervous as the narration says he is trembling, ears/head canonical and body slightly braced, eyes up-left; worried tension, not startled shock. Preserve the body and screen axis. Clarify paw beside rather than covering Milo’s near foot: a visible small ground gap, do not step on or pin him. No new limb geometry unrelated to clearance. Leo remains lying; never stands fully. Preserve the same pair canvas, Leo-left/Milo-right screen axis, intrinsic felt palette, grey Milo paws, cream patch, green mouse eyes, amber lion eyes, mane curls and animal-specific proportions. References 2/3 own respective canonical identities; 4/5 are their own visible measurement guides, never paint guides or apply mouse ratios to lion. No independent head/body resizing. Milo upright projected head fraction 0.39 +/-0.01 applies only at compatible upright pitch; bent/occluded views require comparison, not a fabricated pass. Both mouths closed and toothless. Keep complete characters with margins, genuine transparent alpha, no environment, ground plane, cast shadows, props, symbols, words or watermark. Exactly one output.
